DEPARTMENT OF
Managed Health Care

April 8, 2026

Gavin Newsom, Governor
State of California
Health and Human Services Agency
DEPARTMENT OF MANAGED HEALTH CARE
980 9th Street, Suite 500
Sacramento, CA 95814
Toll-Free: 1-888-466-2219 | Fax: 916-255-5241
Email: helpline@dmhc.ca.gov
www.DMHC.ca.gov

NICOLAS HERNANDEZ
[REDACTED ADDRESS]
CA 9[REDACTED]

Patient: Nicolas Hernandez
DMHC#: 1[REDACTED]
Health Plan: Local Initiative Health Authority for L.A. County (L.A. Care Health Plan)

Dear Nicolas Hernandez:

Thank you for sending your Independent Medical Review (IMR)/Complaint Form to the Department of Managed Health Care (Department).

We closed your complaint because it is about a Medi-Cal pharmacy benefit, service or claim which the Department does not have authority.

Starting January 1, 2022, Medi-Cal pharmacy benefits are handled by the Medi-Cal Rx program which is different from your Medi-Cal plan. To learn more about the program you may visit the Medi-Cal Rx website at https://medi-calrx.dhcs.ca.gov or https://dhcs.ca.gov/individuals/Pages/SUD_County_Access_Lines.aspx.

If you do not agree with a denial or a change of your medications under Medi-Cal, you have the right to a State Hearing through the California State Department of Social Services. There are five (5) ways to submit a request for a State Hearing:

1. BY TELEPHONE: You can call the State Hearing Division at 800-952-5253. Hearing impaired members may use TDD by calling 800-952-8349.

2. BY MAIL: You may mail a State Hearing Request form or your own written request to:
MSC 191737
STATE HEARING DIVISION
CA STATE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES
PO BOX 944243
SACRAMENTO CA 94244-2430

3. IN PERSON: You may turn in a State Hearing Request form or your own written request at the county welfare department in your area.

Protecting the Health Care Rights of More Than 30.2 Million Californians
Contact the DMHC Help Center at 1-888-466-2219 or www.DMHC.ca.gov
